  - `test`: runs only if repo owner is 'vercel', matrix os [ubuntu-latest], node [20, 22], timeout 10 min, checkout, pnpm install, pnpm build, pnpm test, then maybe release (npm install -g npm@latest, pnpm dlx semantic-release)

- P-LIT-ENV-CACHE: Reuse validated build environments
- P-LIT-UNAFFECTED-STEPS: Skip steps using traced dependencies
- P-LIT-SMELL-REPAIR: Repair evidenced configuration smells
- P-LIT-DURATION-PREDICTION: Predict duration - research_only
- P-LIT-UNUSED-OUTPUTS: Remove genuinely unused outputs
